study_identification_part.si4_title: Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objectives: to use a normative modeling approach (centiles) to detect patterns of atypical neuroanatomical maturation across psychosis-related disorders and to map these deviations to molecular and micro-architectural attributes (neurobiological features).
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: Detecting patterns of atypical neuroanatomical maturation across psychiatric disorders requires an interpretable metric standardized by age-, sex- and site-effect. ... In the present study, we aimed to characterize the molecular and micro-architectural attributes (collectively referred here as neurobiological features) that underlie the pattern of cortical atypical maturation in different psychosis-related groups.
